_what: Paradox callback observer for diagnostic LoadFirst sitting leg D. Records the root, same-thread children, callback start/return/error and Clear. RETURNED-UNVERIFIED records callback return only: silent fetch errors and logged-only child errors make remote sync success unobservable here. Every report says sync_success=UNVERIFIED; no remote-sync PASS. Empty is unknown, not proof of no subscriptions. Clear invalidates open attempts even if nothing was queued. MODE unattended logs lifecycle and saved order, then quits; MODE sitting binds Sync read. Edit MODE in the parked payload before each arm. Observes only: no mod-list helper, persistent-data write or save.
mustNotBeListedWhy: The autorun would start a colony and race the menu; forced-inactive changes the pack statuses read beside the verdict; the read, set and pack payloads also quit at the menu and would race this one in MODE unattended.
